data.title: 千反田爱瑠 · 神社初诣振袖和服的端庄回眸·「新年快乐，折木同学」
data.description: 【荒楠神社红鸟居前·初雪初诣】新年参拜的清晨。爱瑠身穿淡紫色印花高档振袖和服，宽大的织锦腰带勾勒出端庄身段，黑发挽成典雅发髻并插着精致花簪。在朱红鸟居与白雪之间，她双手交叠于腹前微微回眸，尽显豪农名门千金的贵气与娇羞。
data.location: 古神社红鸟居与雪景石阶前
data.action: 身着振袖和服双手叠腹回眸微躬，花簪微晃，紫眸含笑祝福
data.lighting: 初雪石阶反光与神社晨曦相映
data.camera: medium full shot, furisode kimono, torii gate, snow falling
data.promptProse: At Arakusu Shrine's red torii on New Year's morning, Eru Chitanda folds both hands before her pale-wisteria furisode and turns slightly back with a shy smile. White crane and cherry patterns accompany the gold obi, black hair arranged with a floral kanzashi. The medium-full framing includes snowy stairs below the gate. Morning light and snow reflection illuminate her headdress and patterned sleeves, while the red torii casts a warm tint onto the adjacent snow.
